card.title: 75th RANGERS

card.flavorText: During WWII the Rangers were special military units of the US Army, made up of volunteers only, and were tasked with carrying out raids in enemy occupied territory and spearheading invasions, much like the British Commandos. What would become the 75th Ranger Regiment was at the start of WWII composed of a single battalion, the 1st Rangers Battalion. In 1942 the battalion fought with British and Canadian commandos in France during an amphibious attack on the port of Dieppe and that same year they landed in Algiers where they carried out successful raids on Italian and Vichy-French military installations. In 1943 the Rangers were expanded to a full regiment, six battalions in total, 1st-5th were deployed in Europe and the 6th in the Pacific where they fought in the Philippines and New Guinea. The 1st, 3rd and 4th battalions were destroyed in a joint operation in the Italian Campaign, but the 2nd and 5th spearheaded the D-Day landings on Omaha beach and fought in several battles after that, such as the Battle for Brest and the Battle of the Hurtgen Forest. It’s noteworthy that the main characters in Steven Spielberg's film classic Saving Private Ryan were men of the 2nd Battalion.
